title: Turn Business Central Environment Telemetry On or Off

facts.text: Create an Azure Application Insights resource to receive telemetry data
Obtain Connection String or Instrumentation Key from the Application Insights resource Overview page
Connection String is recommended for versions after 2020 release wave 2; Instrumentation Key support ended March 31, 2025
For online environments, enable telemetry in admin center by selecting Define and entering connection string
For on-premises single-tenant, set ApplicationInsightsConnectionString in server configuration
For on-premises multitenant, specify connection string per tenant during Mount-NAVTenant
Telemetry ID can be assigned or cleared per user on User Card to track troubleshooting by individual
Same Application Insights resource can be used for multiple tenants and environments
